# Scope: com.noblemaster.lib.i18n (17 methods + 5 fields) and the remaining members of
# com.noblemaster.lib.data (26 methods + 5 fields). Both packages are the localisation stack:
# OrderedProperties parses the .properties bundles, Iso88591Charset decodes their bytes and
# Messages looks strings up. Evidence per symbol:
# LineReader: a = the whole text, b = the read cursor. a(String) is the factory -> of;
#   a() returns the next line (skipping CR/LF) or null at the end -> readLine. Both name choices
# CustomCharset (abstract decoder): a(byte[]) is the template method that walks the bytes,
#   tries every byte length from getMinBytesPerChar() to getMaxBytesPerChar(), and appends the
#   decoded chars -> decode; a()/b()/c() are the per-encoding bounds used by that loop and by the
#   StringBuilder capacity guess (len * c() / a()) -> getMinBytesPerChar/getMaxBytesPerChar/
#   getMaxCharsPerByte; a(int offset, int byteCount, byte[]) counts the characters that a given
#   byte length yields at that offset (0 = not a valid sequence) -> countCharsAt;
#   a(int index, int offset, int byteCount, byte[]) returns one decoded char -> decodeCharAt.
#   Iso88591Charset is the only subclass and implements all bounds as 1 plus a 256-entry table,
#   so it repeats the same five names; its INSTANCE field (formerly a) is the shared singleton
# OrderedProperties: a = insertion-ordered key list, b = key -> value map -> keys / values;
#   a(int) -> getKey ; a() -> size ; a(String)/a(String,String) -> get(key[,default]) ;
#   b(String,String) -> put (a null value removes the key, matching a setter that clears) ;
#   with escapes) ; the private static a(StringBuilder,String) is that escaper -> appendEscaped ;
#   b(String) -> parse (reads a whole bundle text) ; a(char) -> hexValue (the backslash-u digit
#   helper documented in-place after the blank-UI fix) ; a(LineReader,StringBuilder) ->
#   readLogicalLine (joins continuation lines with a trailing backslash).
# Version: a = the shared unknown-version sentinel -> UNKNOWN, b = the "major.minor.build" text ->
#   value; a() -> getUnknown ; a(String) -> parse (validates three numeric parts) ; b() ->
# Messages: a/b/c = current language, current properties and the "CJK punctuation rules apply"
#   flag -> language/properties/cjk. a(Language) and a(Language,String) load a bundle (the latter
#   takes the bundle name and merges the language-specific file) -> load ; the private state
#   setter a(Language,OrderedProperties) -> apply ; a() -> getLanguage ; b()/a(String) list the
#   languages that have a bundle file -> getAvailableLanguages ; c() -> getKeys ;
#   a(String) -> get(key) (returning the inline "[i18n]: " default when absent) ;
#   a(String,Object[]) -> format(key,args) ; c(String) -> getFallback (inline default text only) ;
#   b(String,Object[]) -> formatFallback(text,args) (no bundle lookup) ; the private
#   The two char predicates drive word wrapping in ui.Label: a(char) answers "the line may be
#   broken here" (CJK: everything except the full stop / enumeration comma; otherwise only space
#   and newline) -> canWrapLineAt ; b(char) answers "that break character is consumed, so the next
#   line starts after it" (CJK: only the newline; otherwise space and newline) -> isWrapCharDropped ;
#   d() is the separator used when joining wrapped words -> getWordSeparator.
# No member here is reached by name: bundles are read through parse/put, the charset is a singleton,
# and Messages never reflects over keys. Renaming cannot change bundle parsing or saved data.
